"""Generate and validate one open-loop keyboard-out-of-bin trajectory."""
import os
os.environ.setdefault('RCB_SESSION_LOG', '')
from rcb_robolab import Session
import numpy as np, json, sys, importlib.util
from PIL import Image

s = Session('keyboard_out_of_bin', instance='/app/instance.json')
p = s.primitives()
print('READY', json.dumps({'objects':s.objects(),'ee':s.ee_pose(),'joints':s.joint_positions().tolist(),'status':s.status()},default=lambda x: np.asarray(x).tolist()), flush=True)
for cam, fn in [('egocentric_mirrored_camera','initial_ego.png'), ('over_shoulder_left_camera','initial_over.png'), ('wrist_cam','initial_wrist.png')]:
    try:
        Image.fromarray(s.render_frame(cam)).save('/app/output/'+fn)
        print('SAVED', fn, flush=True)
    except Exception as e: print('CAMERR',cam,repr(e),flush=True)

while True:
    line=sys.stdin.readline()
    if not line or line.strip()=='quit': break
    if line.strip()!='run': continue
    try:
        spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('trajectory_plan','/app/output/plan.py')
        mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
        s.reset()
        s.record_start()
        mod.run(s,p)
        acts=s.record_stop()
        st=s.status()
        print('LIVE',json.dumps({'shape':acts.shape,'status':st,'objects':s.objects()},default=lambda x:np.asarray(x).tolist()),flush=True)
        np.savez('/app/output/trial_actions.npz',actions=acts)
        if st['success']:
            s.save_trajectory(acts,'/app/output/trajectory.npz',meta={'source':'gen.py'})
            print('SAVED_SUCCESS',len(acts),flush=True)
        if len(acts):
            try:
                Image.fromarray(s.render_frame('egocentric_mirrored_camera')).save('/app/output/last_ego.png')
            except Exception as e: print('FRAMEERR',repr(e),flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback; traceback.print_exc();
        if s._recording is not None:
            acts=s.record_stop(); np.savez('/app/output/trial_actions.npz',actions=acts)
            print('PARTIAL',len(acts),flush=True)
print('WORKER_DONE',flush=True)
